items.title: Introducing GPT-6.1 Sol
items.summary: We’re introducing GPT‑6.1 Sol , an upgrade to GPT‑6 Sol that nearly matches GPT‑6 Astra’s intelligence on agentic coding, computer use, and professional work at one-fifth of Astra’s standard input and output token prices.
